name: Outerwear
description: Cashmere, virgin wool, and woven camel — coats and trenches engineered to fall in a single, uninterrupted line. Cut in our Florentine atelier and finished by a single hand.

name: Ready-to-Wear
description: Silk slips, fluid tailoring, and the long silhouette of the season. Garments authored for a quiet life, worn close.

name: Leather Goods
description: Vegetable-tanned in Tuscany and finished by hand. Bags and small objects shaped to weather a generation rather than a season.

name: Footwear
description: Pumps, mules, and low boots built on Italian lasts. Each pair is stitched by a maker whose initials are pressed into the lining.

name: Eyewear
description: Hand-polished acetate and bevelled metalwork from a Cadore workshop. Every frame is adjusted before it leaves the NONGPALM.

name: Accessories
description: Gloves, fine knits, and pieces drawn from the archive — finished by the same eleven seamstresses who tailor our outerwear.
